verdict.rationale: Salesmate's pricing page lists access to publicly available RESTful APIs, and its llms.txt mentions API support for extended workflows, so a first-party public API exists. The pack contains no actual API reference content, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or machine-readable docs at apidocs.salesmate.io, so documentation depth is unproven. Missing for 10: evidenced API reference documentation (endpoints, auth, coverage of CRM objects), machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
